name: Atal Kisan Jyoti Yojana
benefit: Electricity Supply at Concessional Rate: Farmers having metered permanent agricultural pumps up to 10 horsepower are provided electricity at a flat rate of ₹750/- per horsepower per year.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a permanent agricultural pump consumer. - The applicant must have a metered connection. - The applicant’s pump capacity should be up to 10 horsepower.
